nodes.label: Honest Degraded States
nodes.rationale: AI work is queued, paused or replaced with deterministic output when resources are insufficient so degraded capability is never disguised as a complete answer.

nodes.label: Core Services Outrank AI Work
nodes.rationale: POS, financial awareness, customer workflows, evidence and audit must remain responsive even when local models are paused or terminated.

nodes.label: Project OMNISCIENCE Master Product and Technical Specification

nodes.label: Evidence Before Authority
nodes.rationale: Observation, calculation, recommendation, approval and execution are separate permissions, and model confidence alone cannot grant execution authority.

nodes.label: Human-Controlled Consequential Execution
nodes.rationale: Financial, legal, reputational and employee consequences remain human-controlled, while the gateway accepts only exact policy-approved and cryptographically bound payloads.
